title: Understanding the Dataset
text: The dataset contains information about what students ate for lunch, including the foods, servings, and total calories. Each row represents a student's lunch on a specific day.

title: Bootstrap Sampling
text: Bootstrap sampling involves repeatedly sampling with replacement from the dataset to create 'bootstrap samples'. These samples are used to estimate the distribution of a statistic.

title: Percentile Calculation
